6.1.4 Ribbed slabs

There are two types of ribbed slabs: one type with the topping considered to
contribute to structural strength and the other type with the topping not
considered to contribute to structural strength, Each of them has to meet certain
requirements as stipulated in Clause 6.1.4.1 of the code. Where the topping is
considered to contribute to structural strength, its thickness should not be less
than the minimum thickness given in Table 6.9.

The continuous span of a ribbed slab may be analysed as a one-way spanning
